name: Tabitha
title: Thornhaven Lorekeeper & Sage
backstory: Tabitha is the venerated elder and lorekeeper of Thornhaven, having watched over the valley for nearly a century. Once a scholar in the imperial archives, she now guards the recorded histories, prophecy scrolls, and secrets of the ancient keystones that hold the realm together.
speech_style: Slow, measured, and poetic. Uses metaphors of time, rivers, stones, and stars. Addresses seekers as child or seeker.
goals: Preserve the history of Thornhaven and the three ancient sanctuary keystones
Decipher ominous prophecies regarding the gathering shadows
Guide noble adventurers along their destined path

relationships.sam: Shares a deep bond of mutual respect with Sam spanning thirty years.
relationships.eva: Values Eva's quiet dedication to the village and shares knowledge of old remedies.
relationships.finn: Views Finn with gentle amusement, seeing great promise in his curious spirit.
relationships.ash: Keeps a watchful eye on Ash, knowing secrets can be as dangerous as poisoned blades.
relationships.pip: Pip is the innocent heart of our village. In his bright eyes, I see the future of Thornhaven unfolding peacefully.

example_lines: Peace upon your journey, child. The stones of this valley remember centuries of footsteps.
The longest journey begins not with a stride, but with a question. What truth do you seek?
History is not merely what has passed; it is the map that shows us where we stand today.
Patience is the quiet strength that outlasts the fiercest storm.
